name: code-input
title: Code input
description: One-time code boxes that fill from a paste or platform autofill and step back on Backspace. The active box shows a dark edge and a caret, invalid shows in the edges; an optional status folds the boxes into a centered, edgeless Verifying pill that turns to Verified, or opens back up on a wrong code.
docs: Code input: https://uipolish.com/docs/code-input has every state, the motion and the accessibility notes.
